Hi Emma — thanks for the clear outline, this is exactly the sort of info that helps us give pragmatic options. High level, two paths we typically recommend for customers with a pilot -> production trajectory: 

1) Pilot Essentials (hosted->dedicated trial) — lower ramp, faster time-to-value
   - Hosted API for the pilot (shared control plane) with an isolated model variant (snapshot)
   - Optional short-term Dedicated pilot node pool (2x A100 equivalent) for representative QPS
   - Observability: 30-day retention included, add-on for 90-day retention
   - Security: SOC2 evidence + KMS integration available for the production transition
   - Pricing range (pilot): $8k–$25k (depending on node size + data egress)

2) Dedicated-First (private deployment ramp) — recommended if PHI/regulatory or strict VPC required from day one
   - Private control plane, VPC peering, customer-managed KMS, audit log export
   - Reserved capacity (monthly commit) with optional burst pool
   - 90-day observability retention included in the package; audit pack add-on for compliance artifacts
   - Pricing range (pilot + initial commit): $35k–$80k depending on throughput and cache sizing

Pilot credits and discounts: we usually offer a pilot credit that can be applied toward the first year of an annual commitment (credit depends on pilot spend and commitment size). Ben (cc'd) will share the standard discount ladders and pilot-credit mechanics.

A few quick questions to tighten estimates:
- Expected steady QPS and 95th %-ile latency SLO for production?
- Typical sequence length and percent of long-prefix requests (KV cache hit patterns)?
- Any required geo restrictions (EU-only data residency)?

I've attached a short MAP template and will follow up with a draft quote once Ben provides numbers. If Thu 9/16 doesn't work, Mon 9/20 AM PST also works for me.

Cheers,
Alex Martinez

Emma — quick note on pricing mechanics and discounts so you have a concrete starting point: 

- Pilot credit: up to 50% of pilot spend can be credited against year-1 committed spend if customer signs within 60 days of pilot close. Max credit tiers scale with commit size (smaller pilots get smaller credit).
- Standard annual commit discounts: 10% at $150k/year, 18% at $500k/year, 25% at $1M+/year (these are list starting points; we can flex for strategic pilots).
- Audit/compliance add-on (SOC2 artifacts, dedicated evidence package): flat $12k one-time for Private deployments, or $18k for expedited customized evidence bundles.
- Observability retention: 90-day retention is an add-on for Hosted pilots ($5k/month) but included for Dedicated-First packages above a certain commit.

We can create a 3-line quote: Pilot (hosted), Pilot (dedicated node pool), Production (reserved capacity) with clear line items for observability, KMS integration, and audit pack.
